checkpoint_diagnostics.arithmetic_scope: The declared rtol1e-10/atol1e-12 applies only when independently reducing replayed physical errors into the saved JAX selection scalar. Model/snapshot/cache bytes, source identity, comparator reports/recipes/traces and final comparator fingerprints remain exact checks. Record both scalars and their absolute difference; this tolerance never changes selection or permits an alternate checkpoint.
checkpoint_diagnostics.capture: Save immutable parameter/norm snapshots at initialization after the existing finite initial-loss check, and after each existing checkpoint loss evaluation. Record dt/history/horizon/delay, model kind/recipe, source/runtime identity, cache fingerprints, shared error_scale and the already measured selection loss. Preserve all original trace/report/selection/optimizer metadata. Do not run a new initialization/ridge fit to reconstruct step 0, rerun optimization to recover missed checkpoints, mutate parameter trees or consume random draws. Every completed fit must supply all 11 checkpoints; a missed/malformed checkpoint that the optimizer completed is a harness failure. If the existing numeric checks abort an arm, preserve its failure and already captured checkpoints, mark remaining checkpoints unavailable, and never refit to fill them.
checkpoint_diagnostics.implementation_invariant: Observation-only instrumentation may use isolated private fitting modules/scoped hooks without changing any public API or historical source bytes. Verify exact pinned numerical code identity for loss/evaluate/Adam/update/PRNG/checkpoint selection mechanics and audit observer parity, and verify both comparator full revisions exactly. Snapshots and diagnostics remain external to saved model metadata/reports so comparator fingerprints stay exact. No alternate objective, gradients, batches, epoch counts, optimizer schedule or checkpoint criterion.
checkpoint_diagnostics.objective_decomposition: Using identical saved error_scale, record each physical group's contribution sum(normalized_squared_error)/(Nwindows*H*15), as well as per-channel contribution, and require their sum to reproduce the existing development selectionloss (rtol1e-10,atol1e-12). This describes current weighting, not a changed objective.
checkpoint_diagnostics.observer_design: Use a scoped read-only Python frame observer tied to the exact pinned public and private quadratic/bilinear fitting function code objects and AST-identified existing trace/checkpoint source locations. Capture current params/norms at trace initialization after the existing finite initial-loss check and at trace.append after the existing finite checkpoint-loss check. Do not rewrite or replace the numerical loop, mutate frame locals, intercept numerical return values, change random state or rerun missed work. Copy arrays into external immutable snapshots. Restore the prior tracing state in a finally block; the observer is local to the single fit process. Source/code identity and exact expected checkpoint roster are mandatory. Verify instrumented/uninstrumented parity on bounded toy data before real fitting, plus full trusted public/quadratic revision equality. Explicitly disclosed snapshot/diagnostic wall time is additional observation work, not an optimizer budget change.
checkpoint_diagnostics.observer_parity: Before benchmark fitting, deterministic toy parity tests must compare captured versus uninstrumented fitting: final selected parameters/norms, every existing scalar trace entry, selected step, original report and input-cache identities. Capture must read the actual current optimizer parameter tree at each declared step, not the best-so-far tree. In the benchmark, public and quadratic comparator metadata, recipe, full trace, arrays and fingerprint must still exactly reproduce trusted prior revisions. No extra optimizer trajectory or diagnostic ridge re-solve is allowed.
checkpoint_diagnostics.physical_metrics: Replay all256fixeddevelopmentwindows from every captured checkpoint and save per-channel physical MSE by each native horizon, group endpoint/componentRMSE and cumulative-prefixRMSE for velocity3m/s,bodyrate3rad/s,rotation9entries. Report window-weighted group errors and per-development-parent endpointRMSE/p95 at native sample,.05,.15,.25s. Groups are evaluator labels only and never enter model fitting.
checkpoint_diagnostics.replay_integrity: Recompute every saved diagnostic from its anchored snapshot and the frozen dev cache without optimizer/ridge refits; reject coherently altered snapshot/metric/cache/source evidence. The two trusted final comparator revisions must still match exactly. Runtime overhead from capture and diagnostic rollout is reported separately from optimizer work. Diagnostics do not independently reproduce each optimizer update.
checkpoint_diagnostics.scope: Prospectively capture initial and existing100-step checkpoints for all three arms during their single declared optimizer trajectory. Diagnostics use development factual forecasts ONLY. They neither fit another model nor evaluate responses/test queries, and never select or rerank a checkpoint.
checkpoint_diagnostics.selection: Use only the originally selected checkpoint for fresh test forecasts and response probes. Save initial, intermediate and selected dev evidence regardless of whether it improves the hypothesis. No test response scoring of intermediate snapshots and no hindsight checkpoint choice.
checkpoint_diagnostics.source_binding: Keep immutable inherited byte pins in inherited_source_sha256 and the original base/parent inventories. The new runner must enumerate every added observer, snapshot serialization, diagnostic reduction/replay, experiment, matching and decision module and their focused tests in one complete runtime source map before fitting. Record each repository-relative path and full SHA256 in stage/final manifests and checkpoint provenance, including the observer's source and exact pinned numerical-code identity and observer parity audit. Snapshot/reduction replay requires the exact same map and rejects altered, missing or unlisted required modules. New file hashes are measured after implementation is committed and before any trial/fit; no unknown or abbreviated hash stands in for an identity.

aggregation.within_scope: Equal weight per horizon and signal group. Weighted geometric mean of candidate/baseline RMSE ratios, with common floor in physical units applied to numerator/denominator before division. Report absolute RMSE and changes alongside ratios.

angular_repair.interpretation: Prospective material angular repair and response-retention margins. These are engineering experiment criteria, not application accuracy tolerances or equivalence tests.
angular_repair.statistic: Use the same hierarchical available_truth_rmse as headline comparisons; parentRMSEp95 uses the existing parent balancing and NumPylinearquantile. Apply the unchanged physical floors. Weak probes remain in raw response scores. Exact same queries and truth masks for both arms.

decision.availability: Assess each pair independently. Missing model predictions keep all planned rows and make only affected comparisons unavailable/false; an unrelated arm failure cannot erase valid pairwise evidence. All required arms must be available for combined mechanism success. Integrity/source/import/data failures abort harness rather than being relabeled scientific evidence. No prediction substitution.

comparisons.bilinear_public_progress: candidate/baseline(public-excited), using unchanged accept_research_candidate broad progress limits, including response<=.90,factual<=1.05,eachprimary<=1.15,eachscope<=1.50,primary250msparentp95<=1.50.

quadratic_gain_retention.policy: Retain useful velocity/rotation gains through the predeclared weighted and scope/tail aggregate limits. No per-cell or every-channel all-win veto; all condition/group gains and losses remain reported.

comparisons.quadratic_public_context: quadratic/baseline(public-excited), using the same broadprogress limits and keeping known tail failures visible; contextual only, not an extra bilinear success prerequisite.

decision.failure: Keep every failed criterion and all per-condition losses visible. Do not infer the value of qxu from qxx removal alone, or qxx harm from selected checkpoints without saved initialization evidence. Any objective/checkpoint intervention is a separately frozen next mechanism, never added after inspecting this test cohort.
decision.metrics: Use raw endpoint factual/response available-truth RMSE including weak probes, with identical query rosters/masks. Report first-native-step,.05,.15,.25s and whole-prefix errors, parent/cell/scope outcomes, missing truth and finite prediction failures. Use unchanged component groups, units, hierarchical balancing and physical ratio floors.
decision.outcomes: Report separate bilinear_public_progress, quadratic_gain_retention and angular_repair flags. Diagnostic mechanism success requires all three plus finite eligible predictions, matching cohorts and completed integrity/replay/tamper/tests. A supported public-relative gain remains visible even when retention or repair fails. Quadratic/public contextual failure is not an extra veto. If combined diagnostic success fails, retain full tradeoff evidence and choose the next gap without changing margins.
decision.public_promotion: Diagnostic success does not change the public recipe. Bilinear remains research pending the fixed synthetic absolute caps and public fit/predict/update/save/load/JAX/derivative-interface/replay contract qualification. Finite derivatives do not establish physical fidelity; model envelopes, updates and controllers retain separate qualifications. No model catalog or consumer option is introduced.
decision.reference: baseline=public on identical excited data,quadratic=full quadratic on identical excited data,candidate=bilinear-only on identical excited data; hold supplies physical scale. Public-original improvement from earlier cohorts is context only and not this iteration's paired denominator.
decision.tails: Report parent-RMSE p50,p95,max by simulator, scope, horizon, signal group and query kind, using available-truth parent errors and retaining missing-parent counts. p95 is NumPy linear quantile, ratio floors as above. Tail acceptance concerns primary250ms only; all shifted tails remain visible.
decision.uncertainty: 1000 paired parent-bootstrap draws with seed20260918 and the same within-cell parent rosters/indices across all pairwise comparisons. Save distributions and verify common draw hashes where available. Report descriptive95%intervals; no extra retrospective significance gates. The angular repair thresholds use the frozen point estimates, with uncertainty reported descriptively.

evaluation.aggregation: Report each cell and parent. Average branch MSE within origin, origins within parent, parents within cell, cells within scope; sqrt last. Keep physical signal groups separate. Preserve planned, eligible, finite, failed and empty counts. Incomplete truth yields conditional available-truth RMSE, never an unqualified full-cohort score. Baseline/candidate raw response ratios include weak probes, use identical query/truth cohorts, and use the predeclared physical floors and weighting in top-level decision. Any eligible prediction failure invalidates the unqualified arm score; finite subsets remain diagnostics only.
evaluation.decision: Use three predeclared paired comparisons and targeted angular repair; distinguish diagnostic success from public promotion. Arms baseline(public-excited),quadratic(full products),candidate(bilinear-only),hold. Preserve all query slots and identical truth masks.
evaluation.metrics: For each simulator,cell,seed,origin,horizon: group endpoint mean squared error across velocity3,rate3,raw rotation9 and cumulative-prefix MSE separately; report RMSE only after declared averaging. Save raw predictions/targets/responses. Report first native sample error, finite prediction counts, raw rotation orthogonality/determinant errors; no projection to improve scores. Generic envelope component coverage uses the identical truth-eligible queries; nonfinite predictions count uncovered. No trajectory-level coverage claim.
evaluation.population: Factual/response headline queries only for recordings with role=test:84 parents/simulator. Any calibration/training/development diagnostics are separate and never pooled into test scores.

responses.commands: Factual stored parent future command tape; for each channel lower and upper separately, sustain u_j+.1*(bound_j-u_j) across the .25s future. Other channels unchanged. This convex bound interpolation needs no clipping. Save intended and actual deltas, including zero at a bound.
responses.truth: Branch from exact full origin physical/actuator/separation state and wind clock; no re-equilibrating reset, no branch feedback. Simulator RNG is unused; record that explicitly. Factual continuation must replay the parent and cloned state exactly. Preserve earlier complete horizons after a later branch failure. Truth and predicted response are signed branch minus corresponding factual continuation. These are finite responses, not a derivative qualification.
responses.weak: Weak channels remain in all raw-error, ratio-objective and planned-denominator reports. Apply both-signed physical thresholds only to descriptive sign/cosine diagnostics; never filter the progress objective.

fitting.baseline: Call unchanged public glassbox.fit once on the imported excited ordinary-recording collection. Require entire model metadata, parameters, norms, caches, report, contract and revision fingerprint to reproduce prior_architecture_bundle/<sim>/candidate/model.npz exactly. No public-original fit is added in this iteration.
fitting.candidate: Call the existing state_input_model.fit_candidate once on the exact public-excited baseline revision and its384/256cachedwindows. Retain the state_input_model recipe/model format and all existing bilinear preparation, joint ridge, recursive rollout, Adam, selection, envelope and serialization mechanics. The sole architecture contrast to quadratic is removal of autonomous state-state products and their scales/coefficients. No independently fitted public model is created to prepare caches.
fitting.candidate_provenance: Keep existing state-input-interaction-v1 candidate format/recipe/report unchanged; record this ablation ID, current runtime, imported data/source seals, exact baseline cache identity and comparator identities externally. Candidate matching baseline_fingerprint denotes the public-excited revision. Diagnostic snapshot provenance is external and never changes the selected saved revision.
fitting.checkpoint: Minimum finite development rollout loss among step0 and every100 updates through1000, strict improvement replaces current best. No response-based selection, restarts, sweeps or hidden test selection. Nonfinite optimization aborts that arm and is a recorded failure, not a seed retry.
fitting.matching: All three arms share EXACT384training/256development window keys, origins, dt, observed channels and all4cache arrays, all6base normalization arrays, numeric hold-current horizon/channel error_scale and consumer contract. Bilinear/quadratic additionally share exact state-input product scales. Shared seed0,width32,memory8,delay/context/horizon,batch64,1000updates,drawseed10000,Adam/lr.002/clipping5,check100andstrictminimumfiniteexisting development loss. Verify shared architecture-independent initialization draws. Extra initial norm/checking ridge solves inherited from existing wrappers are preparation, not extra optimizer trajectories, and are disclosed; matchedupdatesarenot equalFLOPs or end-to-endcompute.

mechanism.attribution: Candidate/public-excited measures the bilinear package benefit under informative excited data; that benefit was previously unknown. Candidate/quadratic measures end-to-end qxx removal at the same data/update budget. Original-data qxx regressions motivate the hypothesis but do not establish its cause in excited-data models. The current devloss permits angular loss in exchange for larger velocity/rotation improvements; objective/checkpoint allocation remains a separate next hypothesis if this ablation does not repair the tradeoff.
mechanism.candidate: Unchanged bilinear recipe: learned direct qxu=vec(x_hat outer u_hat) in C-order, scaled by frozen training-only product standard deviations, alongside existing affine/history/memory/MLP output. Products do not enter memory/MLP. No state-state products, input-squared products or output/channel/platform branches.
mechanism.removed: Upper-triangular qxx=x_hat[i]*x_hat[j], i<=j, direct autonomous output path. Removal changes the joint ridge solution for remaining coefficients and the resulting optimizer trajectory. It is not inference-time parameter masking and does not hold learned remaining coefficients fixed.

fitting.normalization: Use the existing training-only recipe on the identical excited windows. All shared norms and numeric loss scales must agree byte-exactly; do not reuse original-unexcited moments, change weights or rebalance semantic groups. Bilinear preserves qxu scales; it has no qxx scale. Development data stay byte-identical.
fitting.quadratic: Call unchanged command_excitation_fit.fit_excited once on the identical imported collection, using prior_excitation_bundle/<sim>/original/model.npz as unchanged-development preparation reference, frozen72/24roles and ORIGINAL historical excitation seal. Require entire saved revision to reproduce prior_architecture_bundle/<sim>/quadratic/model.npz exactly. Additional checkpoint snapshots stay external to the artifact/report so exact revision equality retains its meaning.

fresh_confirmation: Every original two-simulator-flight-v1 test seed/ID increases by5000000 (1000000 beyond excited-public-architecture-v1). All original calibration IDs/seeds, conditions, physics, pilots, validity and query rules remain unchanged. Import the identical sealed excited calibration from the original independent-command-excitation-v1 bundle. No data collection change or new excitation tape. Previously inspected cohorts remain diagnostic only.

generation.admission: Supply only calibration parents with at least history_steps+horizon_steps complete valid transitions (75 at100Hz,15 at20Hz). Use their full valid prefix as one recording. Report planned/admitted IDs and conditions. Recompute public automatic dev split on this exact admitted pool. The admitted pool and automatic roles must match the frozen trusted96parent collection and72/24roles. If fit prerequisites fail, record fit failure, never replace data or change role/seed.

cascade.commands: Native X8 control_to_array order is throttle,aileron,elevator. Apply permutation [0,2,1] to expose recorded throttle,elevator,aileron; inverse is the same. Apply trim offsets and dither in recorded order, then inverse-permute before control_from_array/native stepping.
cascade.draws: Draw phases3 uniform[0,2pi] from each recording seed; no initial-state jitter.
cascade.initial: Full trim state with equilibrated actuator/separation state. Trim already includes wind in ground velocity; do not add it again. Declared speed is initial and commanded airspeed, not guaranteed maintained speed.
cascade.integrator: Native Cascade rk4_step with full AircraftState,20 held-command400Hz steps per observation. Sample declared wind at each 2.5ms substep start and hold Environment through all four native stages; preserve native state projection.
cascade.pilot: Pinned public skywalker_x8_controller, with pitch_trim=trim.decision[1], throttle_trim=trim.control.propeller[0], rate_period1,attitude_period1,guidance_period2, initial_cascade_state(trim). At each .05s interval update from the true observed state, using native Environment and DT. Let a=mode_scale,ramp=min(1,t). Setpoints: airspeed=V+ramp*.8*a*sin(.7t+phase0); altitude=100+ramp*2*a*sin(.9t+phase1); NEDheading=-yaw+ramp*.4*a*sin(.7t+phase2). Command=clip(pilot_raw+[0,trim_elevator,trim_aileron]+ramp*a*[.035,.025,.02]*sin([1.3,2.1,1.7]*t+phases),bounds). Save pilot targets and achieved physical ranges.
cascade.trim: One trim_straight_flight per speed/heading/initial-wind combination, altitude100m, flight_path_angle_rad0, native heading=-NWUheading, density1.225kg/m3, gravity9.81m/s2, residual_tolerance1e-4,max_evaluations300; all other defaults/source pinned. Use returned full state and control, no warmup/repair/retry. A failed trim is a setup outcome for affected recordings. Nonfinite full trim state/control, unsuccessful trim, or trim command outside the declared benchmark box is a setup failure; never clip or repair the equilibrium prefix.

crazyflow.draws: After initial jitter, draw phases3 uniform[0,2pi], frequencies3 uniform[.3,.65]Hz, and amplitudes3 uniform low[.2,.5,.25] high[.55,1.1,.65]rad. Multiply amplitudes by mode_scale.
crazyflow.initial: Position[0,0,4]m, hidden RPM at nominal hover. Draw velocity jitter uniform[-.5,.5]^3, attitude tangent[-.2,.2]^3, rates[-.3,.3]^3 in this order. v0=Rz(yaw)@([speed,0,0]+velocity_jitter); q0=qyaw times quaternion_exp(attitude_tangent), body rates remain the drawn body-frame vector. Left-compose desired reference by the same yaw. Speeds are initial ground speeds, not maintained targets.
crazyflow.integrator: Dart RK4 of public Crazyflow first_principles.dynamics with rotor dynamics; normalize quaternion after each substep. No upstream Sim floor or RPM clipping. This is declared free flight, not contact simulation.
crazyflow.pilot: Reuse pinned Dart learning.py attitude/altitude excitation equations: desired rotation is exp(amplitude*sin(2pi*frequency*t+phase)), left-composed by heading; desired rates are the analytic angle-vector derivative. Alpha=-18*quaternion_log_error(desired,actual)-7*(body_rate-desired_rate). Collective=hover-.10*(z-4)-.12*vz+.06*sin(4t). Command=clip(collective+.25*MOTOR_MIXER.T@(alpha/[232,232,30]), motorbounds). No translational speed controller.
crazyflow.wind: At every RK4 evaluation add the explicit relative-air-drag acceleration -R D R^T wind_nwu/mass, where D is the pinned Crazyflow body drag matrix (negative damping). This is the wind extension in pinned Dart observer_control.py, independent of its controller imports. Save wind/force schedules.

generation.randomness: Independent NumPy PCG64 seeded by each fixed recording seed; no redraw, retry, seed selection, adaptive condition tuning or candidate selection. No simulator stochastic disturbances. Exact draw order is fixed below.
generation.time_arithmetic: Parent and branch use the same compiled advance kernel and integer global time indices. Crazyflow RK stages use integer1ms ticks (within each2ms substep offsets0,1,1,2). Cascade substep Environment times are integer global400Hz indices divided by400. No accumulated floating time or alternate branch arithmetic.
generation.validity: Record the entire generated raw parent including invalid tail if numerically available. Valid prefix ends before first nonfinite full state/command, altitude<.5m, or quaternion norm differing from1 by>1e-6. No speed/rate performance cutoff. Save failure reason/index and all achieved speed/rate/attitude/altitude ranges. Failed setup/runtime and below-ground conditions remain in the360-parent roster, never redraw. Predictions use only truth-valid histories and targets. Apply these validity checks at recorded observation boundaries and outgoing issued commands, not intermediate RK stages; full hidden state is checked at those same boundaries.
generation.wind: Primary, heading, speed and maneuver cells are calm. Constant wind=[2,0,0]m/s NWU from t0. Gust=[2*sin(pi*(t-.5)/2)^2,0,0]m/s for .5<t<2.5, otherwise0. Crazyflow evaluates wind at every RK4 stage; Cascade samples at each400Hz substep start and holds it through native RK4 stages. Use identical global wind clock for all counterfactual branches. Cascade native wind=NED[x,-y,-z]. Save the actual integration wind schedules. Report wind shifts separately: unexpected forcing is not pure identification error.

imported_calibration.excited: Materialize each simulator/excitation directory from prior_excitation_bundle by copying its sealed files and seal.json byte-exactly. These are explicitly imported historical data with historical runtime and common-data links, not newly generated evidence. Verify complete source bundle anchor and every copied payload/seal. Record new runtime and imported source identity separately in simulator/reuse.json. Do not rewrite imported metadata, timestamps, runtime claims, data seals, recording IDs, arrays, roles or prefix validity.
imported_calibration.failures: Preserve all historical52/96Crazyflow calibration failures (48training/4development), every valid prefix and all72/24roles. Cascade retains96/96completecalibration. No parent replacement, lengthening, easier conditions or new command draw. Insufficient/mismatched data is explicit failure, never permission to recollect.
imported_calibration.learner_input: Build ordinary recording collections through unchanged flight.collection_and_trajectories on original or imported excitation directories. Public fit receives only the ordinary collection, no forced roles, hidden simulator state, excitation labels, cloned supervision or special options.
imported_calibration.original: Regenerate common original calibration with the existing pinned generator; require all96parents and roles to match the trusted original baseline and preceding study. Only fresh test seeds change. All96originalcalibration parents are admitted; preserve72training/24developmentroles.
imported_calibration.replay: Verify imported files against trusted prior source; invoke pinned prior excitation physics replay against that trusted source and its original protocol/runtime, then reverify copied files. No new random tape or changed collection is admitted. New common physics/query data replay under this protocol separately.

integrity.before_fit: Freeze and commit this protocol and all implementation/tests before new simulations/fits. Seal common fresh test data and verify exact historical excitation imports for both simulators. Keep original calibration/development unchanged. Run exactly one declared optimizer trajectory per arm; capture all prospective checkpoint snapshots within that run. Require exact trusted comparator refits and exact same-data matching before confirmation scores.
integrity.execution: Bound generation/fit/replay jobs; log stages and completed records. Preserve native/runtime outcomes; programming bugs abort the harness and require tested committed fixes, not relabeling as a model failure. No implicit retries with new seeds or parameters. Each timeout is retained as an explicit incomplete-stage outcome; no parameter/seed change or automatic retry. Programming fixes can restart the unchanged deterministic stage under a new committed implementation with old failure logs retained.
integrity.historical: Keep all preceding protocols/results and99base+4parent+28inherited source/test bytes unchanged. New ablation/checkpoint instrumentation modules/tests must be committed and captured by byte hashes in each stage/final bundle. Prior architecture protocol/bundle and original excitation protocol/bundle remain independently anchored. Do not rewrite imported runtime or source data seals.
integrity.replay: Replay fresh common physics/query arrays; verify imported excitation against its exact original source and replay original excitation under historical protocol/runtime. Replay all selected-model predictions, full raw metrics, pairwise decisions/tails/bootstrap and angular gates. Replay development diagnostics from every saved snapshot without optimizer/ridge refits. Independent NumPy250ms physical/tail/angular reductions and matched cache/base/productnorm/loss-scale checks. Reject raw/coherently resealed model, initial/intermediate checkpoint, imported data/provenance, history/commands, source, prediction+metrics, diagnostic, decision and physics alterations.

named_gap: Retain learned velocity/rotation gains while repairing Crazyflow angular forecasts and tails

runtime.imports: Current isolated Glassbox checkout first; Cascade only from clean committed archive e8f6ba6; installed Crazyflow files must match pinned clean1142d284 sources. Never import Dart controller modules. Record actual import roots, loaded source/asset hashes and native package/runtime identities before data and fits.

scope: Remove only the learned autonomous state-state output-product path from the excited-data quadratic workflow. Compare bilinear-only with public-excited and quadratic-excited on identical imported recordings, numeric loss scales and update budgets. This is end-to-end architecture removal including joint ridge allocation and subsequent optimization, not zeroing fitted quadratic parameters. No collection adaptation, new learner options or changed checkpoint criterion.

signals.commands: Issued boundary command held throughout each recorded interval. Crazyflow desired thrust/max-thrust in Glassbox FL/FR/RR/RL order, bounds thrust_min/thrust_max through1. Cascade order throttle,elevator,aileron; bounds[0,1],[-.35,.35],[-.35,.35]. Save realized actuator outputs separately; never substitute them for issued commands.
signals.configuration: One immutable physical configuration per simulator across all conditions. Declare exact identical ordered channel identity strings and timing for calibration and evaluation; wind remains unobserved in all learned arms.
signals.observed: All learned arms receive the same15 Euclidean channels: world NWU velocity3 [m/s], body FLU rates3 [rad/s], body-to-world rotation matrix9 row-major, using existing OBSERVED_CHANNELS and observed_from_state. Neither positions, hidden actuators, wind, pilot state, true equations nor future observations enter fitting. Stored canonical/full simulator states serve evaluation only.
signals.prefix: All learned arms use the actual required .5s observed context without padding. Historical structured workflow is not rerun or used for acceptance in this iteration.
signals.truth_state: Canonical rigid_body_13_nwu_flu_wxyz_v1: position3, world velocity3, WXYZ body-to-world quaternion4, body rates3. Save full simulator internal state separately for replay/branching.
